workspace.sourceInfo: The vehicle can inherit deposit, delivery and discounts from the shop, or keep its own policy set.
workspace.customizingTitle: Customising {vehicle} only; other vehicles are not affected.
workspace.inheritBanner: The shared policy is active. Changes made in Shop settings apply to this vehicle automatically.
workspace.resetBody: Reset to the shop policy: every customisation for this vehicle is removed and it inherits the shared settings again.
workspace.unsavedTitle: You have changes that are not applied yet
workspace.selfDriveInfo: Base price for self-drive rental; weekend and hourly prices are optional.
workspace.weekdayInfo: Required base price for self-drive, used on weekdays and as the fallback when no weekend price is set.
workspace.weekendInfo: Leave empty to use the weekday price on weekends too.
workspace.hourlyInfo: Leave empty if the vehicle is not rented by the hour.
workspace.longTermInfo: Package price = base monthly price × months, minus the commitment discount.
workspace.monthlyInfo: Price of one month. Renters choose {packages}-month packages; without this price the vehicle cannot publish long-term rental.
workspace.withDriverInfo: These rates include the driver; the in-city rate is the base the system falls back to when another rate is missing.
workspace.inCityInfo: Required to publish the chauffeured service.
workspace.interCityInfo: Leave empty to estimate from the in-city rate; the surcharge is confirmed on approval.
workspace.oneWayInfo: Leave empty to estimate from the nearest tier: intercity, then in-city.
workspace.promoInfo: Discounts the self-drive rent on quotes and new bookings; does not touch long-term, chauffeured, surcharges or deposits.
workspace.promoPercentInfo: Applies to the weekday, weekend and per-day self-drive prices.
workspace.promoOffHint: Renters see the full price with no discount badge.
workspace.previewEmpty: Enter a weekday price to preview
workspace.inheritedDescPolicy: Collateral, delivery and duration discounts are inherited from the shop.
workspace.inheritedDescNone: The shop has no collateral, delivery or duration-discount policy yet.
workspace.sumDeliveryOn: On ({count, plural, one {# distance tier} other {# distance tiers}})
workspace.noPolicyTitle: The shop has no rental policy yet
workspace.noPolicyBody: This vehicle has no collateral, delivery or discount rules. Configure them at {link} or switch to a vehicle-specific policy.
workspace.confirmPriceBody: {vehicle} is public. Changing the price sends it back to review and hides it from the marketplace until the platform approves. Bookings confirmed earlier keep their old price.
workspace.confirmSaveOverrideBody: Changes apply to {vehicle} only, from new bookings onward — other vehicles and confirmed bookings are untouched.
workspace.confirmSavePriceTitle: Save the price for this vehicle?
workspace.confirmSavePriceBody: The new price applies to {vehicle} only, from new bookings onward. The vehicle keeps inheriting the shop policy.

sections.depositInfo: Collateral is what the shop holds against risk: a cash deposit, an asset/document, or nothing. It is separate from identity verification, which every rental needs.
sections.collateralCashDesc: The renter pays an amount, refunded when the vehicle is returned.
sections.collateralAssetDesc: The renter leaves a document or asset instead of money — the shop holds no cash.
sections.collateralNoneDesc: No collateral. The vehicle carries the "No collateral" badge on the marketplace.
sections.depositAmountInfo: A fixed VND amount collected separately from rent, not discounted, applying to new bookings only. Confirmed bookings keep their old deposit.
sections.assetTypesHelp: The renter only needs to provide ONE of the selected types.
sections.noneBody: Vehicles under this policy show the "No collateral" badge and are filterable by it on the marketplace.
sections.deliveryInfo: Fees are based on the one-way distance from the shop to the renter's pickup point.
sections.fromKmInfo: The start is taken from the previous tier's end so there are no gaps.
sections.toKmInfo: Upper limit of this tier. Tiers must increase.
sections.feeInfo: Enter 0 if delivery is free within this distance.
sections.radiusInfo: Must match the end of the last tier. Beyond it renters see “Contact the host” and the shop quotes manually.
sections.deliveryOff: Off — renters cannot request home delivery when booking.
sections.overtimeInfo: Charged at return, after the free grace period and rounded by the configured unit.
sections.overtimeFeeInfoLabel: About the fee per extra hour
sections.overtimeFeeInfo: Fee for each hour the renter returns late after the grace period.
sections.overtimeGraceInfo: Lateness that does not incur a fee yet.
sections.overtimeRoundingInfo: Smallest time step used when rounding the fee.
sections.overtimeFormula: Late fee = (actual late hours) × {fee}. Calculated at return.
sections.overtimeFormulaMissing: No hourly fee set — late fees are agreed manually at return.
sections.discountInfo: Long-term only. Renters get the highest tier their package reaches; tiers do not stack — e.g. a 9-month package gets the 6-month tier if no higher tier exists.
sections.percentInfo: Percentage taken off the full package price.
sections.noteInfo: A short note so the shop remembers what this tier is for.
sections.legacyTitle: {count, plural, one {# legacy tier} other {# legacy tiers}} by DAY could not be converted to packages
sections.legacyBody: These tiers are no longer priced. Re-select tiers by package and save; nothing is converted automatically to avoid unexpected price changes.
sections.discountOff: Off — every booking pays the full base rent.
